credit_line: 125th Anniversary Acquisition. Purchased with funds contributed by Marion Boulton Stroud, the gift (by exchange) of Dr. and Mrs. Paul Todd Makler, and gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, 1997
description: Depicts Beauford Delaney, an American modernist painter. In this composition, he looks out at the viewer with a neutral expression. The black, gray, and white portrait shows only Delaney's head. Exposed white paper surrounds the image.
